title: Retail Industry AI Vendor Jiuzhang Data Raises ¥10M Series A+ from Yecao
summary: On May 26, 2022, pan-retail industry digitalization vendor Jiuzhang Data (九章数据) (founded 2018; BSAI) closed a ¥10M Series A+ from Yecao Ventures — for SaaS R&D, AI product matrix, talent, and GTM. Verticals: retail, hotel, property. Apr’22 launched iDAS SaaS cloud data platform

html:
Unique Research · Company / Funding · May 26, 2022

On May 26, 2022, pan-retail industry digitalization vendor Jiuzhang Data (九章数据) (founded 2018; BSAI) closed a ¥10M Series A+ from Yecao Ventures — for SaaS R&D, AI product matrix, talent, and GTM. Verticals: retail, hotel, property. Apr’22 launched iDAS SaaS cloud data platform + iReport store workbench + supply-chain AI 2.0 for supermarkets and consumer brands. DaaS + MaaS mid-platform; SaaS modules or private deploy.

— END —
